thesis: COLM is in a clean post-earnings uptrend with margin-driven profit recovery, positive free cash flow and low dilution risk. It is also a consumer-defensive-style name holding up while tech sells off. The constructive entry is a pullback into the 72.4-74.0 zone with a stop at 70.2, which gives 2.5 reward/risk toward 80.8. The setup is only moderate. The stock is extended, trades above the analyst mean target, and the regime is risk-off, so this is a small-size, pullback-only long, not a chase.
